title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Provisions on Supervision and Inspection Work of People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Provisions on the Supervision and Inspection Work of the People's Courts

Fa Fa [2014] No. 9

To: all higher people's courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Sub-Court of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The revised Provisions on the Supervision and Inspection Work of the People's Courts are hereby issued. Please implement them conscientiously in light of the actual work, and promptly report any problems discovered during implementation to the Supreme People's Court.

June 4, 2014

Provisions on the Supervision and Inspection Work of the People's Courts

(Revised in June 2014)

Chapter I General Provisions

Article 1 These Provisions are formulated to further strengthen and improve the supervision and inspection (hereinafter referred to as supervision and inspection) work of the people's courts, clarify the tasks of supervision and inspection, standardize the work procedures for supervision and inspection, and enhance the efficiency of supervision and inspection.

Article 2 The supervision and inspection work of the people's courts refers to the supervision and inspection of major decisions and deployments of the people's courts, important special work, and matters assigned by relevant organs such as the Party committee at the same level or the next higher level and the Standing Committee of the People's Congress and their leaders, by a higher people's court and its leaders, or by the leaders of the same court.

Article 3 Supervision and inspection work shall focus on the central tasks, serve the overall situation, highlight key points, make overall plans, be innovative and pragmatic, act in accordance with rules and maintain confidentiality, so as to achieve scientific, efficient, and clean supervision and inspection.

Chapter II Organizational Structure, Personnel and Duties

Article 4 The Supreme People's Court and higher people's courts shall establish specialized supervision and inspection work institutions or departments, responsible for supervising and urging the supervision and inspection matters undertaken by lower people's courts and by each unit within the same court.

The head of the supervision and inspection department of a higher people's court shall generally be selected and appointed as a division-level cadre.

Intermediate people's courts and primary people's courts that have the conditions may establish specialized supervision and inspection work institutions; those that do not have the conditions shall, as the case may be, assign full-time or part-time supervision and inspection staff.

Article 5 The duties of the supervision and inspection department mainly include:

(1) Supervision and Urging. To supervise and urge the implementation of major decisions and deployments of the people's courts, important special work, and matters assigned with instructions by leaders.

(2) Reporting and Notification. To promptly report to the relevant organs and their leaders on the implementation of supervision and inspection matters; to regularly summarize and notify each undertaking unit of the implementation status of supervision and inspection matters.

(3) Assisting Investigations. To assist the leaders of the same court in resolving issues arising from the implementation of decisions and deployments; upon authorization, to participate in the investigation and handling of certain important issues.

(4) Comprehensive Analysis. To comprehensively analyze problems of a universal or trending nature in supervision and inspection work, and put forward opinions and suggestions for solving the problems.

(5) Assessment and Evaluation. To organize and carry out assessment and evaluation of the completion of supervision and inspection tasks by lower people's courts and by each unit within the same court.

Article 6 Each unit within the Supreme People's Court and higher people's courts shall designate a leading person to be in charge of supervision and inspection work, responsible for guiding, coordinating, and tracking the implementation of supervision and inspection matters undertaken by that unit; and designate one person as a part-time liaison for supervision and inspection work, responsible for cooperating with the person undertaking the matter in that unit and the supervision and inspection department in implementing the supervision and inspection matters.

Article 7 People's courts at all levels shall assign personnel with strong political qualities, high professional standards, practical work style, and strict discipline to carry out supervision and inspection work. Supervision and inspection staff shall generally possess trial professional titles.

Chapter III Content and Methods of Supervision and Inspection

Article 8 The content of supervision and inspection work mainly includes:

(1) Matters that, in documents of a higher people's court or the same court, require reporting on implementation status or need supervision and inspection; matters that require supervision and inspection in the Work Report of the People's Court submitted annually to the People's Congress.

(2) Matters that, among the decisions made at various work meetings convened by the people's court, meetings of the Party leading group of the same court, meetings of the president, and special work meetings chaired by court leaders, require reporting on implementation status or need supervision and inspection.

(3) Matters that require supervision and inspection in important special work carried out by the people's court.

(4) Matters that require supervision and inspection as assigned by relevant organs such as the Party committee at the same level or the next higher level and the Standing Committee of the People's Congress and their leaders, with instructions.

(5) Matters that require supervision and inspection as assigned by a higher people's court and its leaders or the leaders of the same court, with instructions.

(6) Other matters that require supervision and inspection.

Article 9 Supervision and inspection work is generally carried out by means of sending a letter to urge, online urging, holding coordination meetings, telephone urging, etc.

For supervision and inspection of major matters or when the handling status is not reported after a reminder, the supervision and inspection department may send personnel to conduct on-site supervision and inspection, or as the case may be, organize relevant units to conduct special research, and if necessary, form a special supervision and inspection team to conduct joint supervision and inspection.

Chapter IV Procedures for Supervision and Inspection

Article 10 Supervision and inspection work generally includes the procedures of project registration, preparation of opinions for submission, assignment, handling, feedback, reminder, reporting, return visit and re-examination, project conclusion and archiving, etc.

Article 11 Project Registration

Matters assigned by relevant organs such as the Party committee at the same level or the next higher level and the Standing Committee of the People's Congress and their leaders, by a higher people's court and its leaders, shall be registered as projects by the supervision and inspection department after obtaining approval from the leaders of the same court; matters assigned with instructions by leaders of the same court shall be directly sent to the supervision and inspection department for project registration; for supervision and inspection of the implementation of major decisions and deployments or the conduct of important special work, the supervision and inspection department may present a project registration report and, after obtaining approval from the responsible leader, register the project.

The registration content includes the project number, summary of content, leader giving instructions, time of instructions, content of instructions, assigning unit, time of assignment, undertaking unit, cooperating unit, time limit for handling, record of reminders, handling result, time of completion, etc.

Article 12 Preparation of Opinions for Submission

The supervision and inspection department shall, based on the content of the incoming document and the division of functions, prepare opinions for handling and submit them to the relevant leader for approval.

Article 13 Assignment

The assignment of supervision and inspection matters shall generally take the form of a supervision letter. The supervision letter shall specify the origin of the assigned matter, the requirements, the time limit for feedback on the progress or the handling result, and attach relevant materials on the supervision and inspection matter. For urgent matters, assignment may be made by telephone, with a record of the telephone call, and the supervision letter shall be issued afterwards without delay.

The supervision and inspection department shall generally, within 1 working day, transmit the supervision letter and related materials to the undertaking unit; if the supervision and inspection department handles the matter itself, it shall determine the person undertaking the matter within 1 working day.

For matters with overlapping tasks or matters handled jointly involving several units, the lead unit and cooperating units shall be determined at the time of assignment. When opinions between the units are inconsistent, the supervision and inspection department shall, as the case may be, promptly conduct coordination.

Article 14 Handling

After receiving a supervision and inspection task, the undertaking unit shall handle it seriously and promptly. For matters handled jointly, the lead unit shall proactively contact and consult with the cooperating units, and the cooperating units shall actively cooperate.

Article 15 Feedback

The undertaking unit shall feedback the handling result or progress within the time limit specified in the supervision letter; if it cannot be completed on time due to special circumstances, it shall feedback the progress and explain the reasons, and the time limit for completion may be appropriately extended as the case may be.

For matters handled jointly, the cooperating units shall actively report the handling status to the lead unit, and the lead unit shall uniformly feedback the handling result.

When a lower people's court reports status to a higher people's court, it shall affix the court seal; when a unit within the same court reports status to the supervision and inspection department, it shall be signed and approved by the unit's leader or affixed with the unit's seal. For urgent matters, feedback may be made by telephone first, with written materials provided afterwards.

The supervision and inspection department shall carefully review the handling status reported by the undertaking unit; if necessary, it may refer the matter to the relevant unit within the same court for review; if the feedback does not meet the requirements, it shall return the matter to the undertaking unit for re-investigation and re-reporting.

Article 16 Reminder

The supervision and inspection department shall timely monitor the handling status of supervision and inspection matters; for matters that have not been closed within the time limit or for which the handling status has not been promptly reported, a reminder shall be issued promptly.

After a reminder has been issued by the supervision and inspection department, the undertaking unit shall report the handling status within 1 week.

Article 17 Reporting

The supervision and inspection department shall promptly prepare a supervision and inspection work report, or refer the matter to the relevant unit within the same court to prepare a supervision and inspection work report, or urge the undertaking unit to promptly prepare a handling status report, and submit it to the relevant organ or leader. The report shall be factual, with clear views, concise wording, and standardized language.

If the relevant organ or leader requests a special briefing, the supervision and inspection department shall make the necessary arrangements.

Article 18 Return Visit and Re-examination

For important supervision and inspection matters that are of concern to leaders, society, and the people, the supervision and inspection department shall promptly conduct on-site return visits and re-examinations to ensure that the issues are properly resolved.

For the implementation of important speeches and instructions made by leaders during inspection and research trips, the supervision and inspection department shall promptly conduct return visits, urge and promote the implementation of work, and report the relevant status to the leaders.

Article 19 Project Conclusion and Archiving

After the supervision and inspection task is completed, the project shall be concluded and registered promptly; if it is necessary to urge other units to continue handling, a new project shall be established.

After the supervision and inspection task is concluded, the relevant documents shall be promptly filed and archived in accordance with the relevant provisions on archives management and document handling.

Chapter V Supplementary Provisions

Article 20 These Provisions shall be interpreted by the General Office of the Supreme People's Court. Each higher people's court may, based on its actual circumstances, formulate implementing measures and report them to the General Office of the Supreme People's Court for record.

Article 21 These Provisions shall come into effect as of July 1, 2014. The Provisions on the Supervision and Inspection Work of the People's Courts (Fa Fa [2009] No. 31) shall be simultaneously abolished.
